messages:
Nina (partnerships): Quick thread: finalizing the partner support/escalation path for the EdgeWorks + IronGrid joint marketplace listing. Need channel names, who gets paged, and warroom automation. Pinged @Omar, @Li, @Jae.

Omar (hw-partner-ops): For external partner L2 we usually use a shared channel + a private warroom when things get hot. Proposal: `#ew-ig-support` (shared) and `#ew-ig-warroom-<yyyymmdd>-<seq>` for SEV1.

Li (si-lead): That works. IronGrid wants their on-call shadow invited to the warroom within 60s of creation. Can we add an invite webhook?

Jae (oncall-sre): Pager rules: SEV1 -> page `sre-rota` and `partner-ops` immediately, create warroom, start bridge. SEV2 -> post to shared channel + 15m check-in. SEV3 -> ticket only.

Marta (product): Also need a short pinned checklist for the shared channel so partner reps know what to do before warroom: <=6 bullets.

Li (si-lead): I'll draft the checklist: 
```
1) Confirm affected devices/customers
2) Verify firmware/model version + recent deploys
3) Grab logs & failing traces
4) Try safe mitigation (rollback/route/disable feature)
5) Add IronGrid on-call + note contact method
6) If no progress in 15m, escalate to SEV1
```

Omar (hw-partner-ops): Perfect. For automation, DeployBot can create the warroom via API and DM the bridge link + invite the partner bot account. Example call: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal/api/warrooms -d '{"partner":"edgeworks","integration":"irongrid","env":"prod","trigger":"alert"}'
```

DeployBot: Warroom API ready. Response example -> {"room":"#ew-ig-warroom-20260408-01","bridge":"https://meet.red/bridges/zz9"} (will DM link).

Jae (oncall-sre): Add a fallback: if partner bot doesn't join warroom within 3 minutes, page `partner-liaison` and the SRE lead.

Clara (customer-success): Also request a customer-facing status template for partner incidents. I'll own that and add it to pinned resources.

Nina (partnerships): Owners and action items:
- Omar: implement invite webhook + one-click warroom button in `#ew-ig-support` (owner: Omar)
- Li: pin the checklist and provide IronGrid on-call details (owner: Li)
- Jae: update pager rules in alertmanager to call warroom API for SEV1 (owner: Jae)
- Clara: customer comms template and quick escalation note (owner: Clara)
- Marta: ensure marketplace listing has the right contact pointers (owner: Marta)

Marta (product): Suggest we add a small table in the runbook showing who owns customer comms, bridge ops, and postmortem. Keeps handoffs clear.

Li (si-lead): One more item: for hardware faults where device telem is delayed, add a "degraded telemetry" flag so we know to request logs directly from IronGrid support.

Omar (hw-partner-ops): I'll add that to the handoff doc. Link draft -> https://redwood.internal/handbooks/edgeworks-irongrid-handoff (will update).

Jae (oncall-sre): Dry-run plan: start a simulated SEV in 45 minutes to validate warroom creation + partner invite + paging. Who can observe?

Nina (partnerships): I'll coordinate. Li, Omar, Clara, Marta please join.

DeployBot: Reminder scheduled -> dry-run in 45m.

Li (si-lead): 👍 I'll be there.

Omar (hw-partner-ops): 👍

Clara (customer-success): will review comms.

Jae (oncall-sre): I'll flip the alert rule to point at test endpoint for the dry-run and flip it back after.

Nina (partnerships): Great. If no objections I'll create `#ew-ig-support` now and invite IronGrid's support bot. Closing thread after dry-run. :thumbsup:
